name: terminal-structures-v1
loss_rationale: conditional-mean reader needed for preregistered medoid hedging hypothesis; no pair/rank objective; old pilot unchanged
common_prefix: FIFO until q; actual candidates q-6,q-5,q-4; one deletion then freeze
confirmation: never generated by prepare; requires confirm-open with frozen student manifest and successful development K2 gates
teacher_attention: current frozen reader score at actual future query feature, candidate age q+h-t recorded; content score does not use ages; mean softmax over plans and horizons
teacher_distribution_limit: reader trained at query only; future-query attention teacher is an explicitly out-of-origin salience adaptation
sampling: reader equal task, equal history size; student export weights equal task and family
